newsitem.title: UK: Mobil North Sea gas well tests at over 30 mln cfd.
newsitem.headline: Mobil North Sea gas well tests at over 30 mln cfd.

text.p: US oil and gas major Mobil said it has successfully tested commercial volumes of gas at exploration well 48/12d-9 in the UK sector of the southern North Sea.
The flow rate is in excess of 30 million cubic feet a day, enough to satisfy the average domestic demand of a city the size of Aberdeen.
The well is 5 miles west of the Galahad platform on Block 48/12d, around 45 miles north of Bacton in Norfolk.
Mobil said in a statement that it would now start evaluating development options with partner Brabant Petroleum.
